ci_reader.boundary: Public historical issuer envelope domains and content addresses checked; original HMAC secret unavailable. Fresh full indexes and actual kernels independently establish exact-input identity and verdict agreement. Historical timing observations are recomputed arithmetically, not remeasured.
ci_reader.rust_binary_scope: Freshly built from exact checked-out research source; cross-host bit-identical Rust binary is not assumed.

independent-719.scope: Independent persisted-evidence checks and fresh exact-export full-kernel replay; no performance claim

native-335.scope: Native identity is an optional accelerator. Successful native indexes equal the original Python structure exactly. Native declines use Python identity and still require the existing checker on changed bytes. Backend caches are populated separately; evidence IDs and tool provenance differ. This qualification makes no claim that incremental checking is faster than direct full checking.

old-binary-251.binary_boundary: Separately compiled source-reference baseline; historical executable byte equality is not claimed.

original-197.scope: Authenticated selected-obligation work reduction and exact-export oracle agreement. Timing medians are observations; edit speedup is not assumed. The bounded Lean theorem does not verify the NDJSON dependency extractor or production kernel locality.

retained_protected.review_boundary: Compact contains the protected aggregator only. The raw 246/229 retained matrices are absent; their individual records were checked by the CI publisher, not independently inspected in this inventory.

scope_limits: Summary inventory and hash/source/count bindings only. No local kernel replay, project import, new gate execution or economic arithmetic was performed.
Gate records overlap, include repeated invocations and protocol checks, and must not be summed as independent theorem counts.
Historical issuer HMACs were not reauthenticated by the public CI reader; its explicit false flag and boundary are retained. Runtime parity summaries separately record issuer-HMAC checks.
Key-resigned parser adversaries possess issuer authority; injected bytes are not asserted to be outputs of the source producer.
Cold latestness depends on a caller-supplied expected head; there is no external monotonic service or general rollback-freshness proof.
The bounded Lean theorem does not verify the NDJSON dependency extractor, source/export/parser/identity executable bridge, or production kernel locality.
Workloads are frozen original and expanded Lean/Std universes and scheduled source changes; no all-Lean, unrestricted edit, new axiom-policy, asymptotic or memory-peak conclusion follows.
An UNKNOWN update is a refusal to issue evidence, not a kernel proof of invalidity. Exception refusals without result status are kept separate from UNKNOWN and REJECTED.
Persistence failures prevent head/state promotion and in-place reuse; a genuine prior-kernel-acceptance orphan receipt may exist, as explicitly recorded by those controls.
Separately compiled historical source baselines do not imply historical executable byte identity.

expanded.adversary_scope: key-resigned parser falsifiers possess issuer authority; separate forged-HMAC controls exercise unauthenticated attackers; injected bytes are not claimed to be source-producer output
